title: Phoenix Contact CHARX SEC-3100 Improper Access Control Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of Phoenix Contact CHARX SEC-3100 devices.
